15003.story: As of Oct 6, the 2022 census value of land and buildings in Honolulu County runs $29,887 an acre, highest of 4 in Hawaii. That is up 20.5% from $24,794 in 2017, 3.8% a year, and well above the state median of $12,660. Renters work a good share of it, with 56% of farmland rented in 2022.

15007.story: As of Oct 6, the census value of land and buildings in Kauai County was $13,236 an acre in 2022. That was up 47.4% from $8,982 in 2017, or 8.1% a year, and up from $7,600 in 2012. It sits above the state median of $12,660 and ranks 2nd highest of 4. 22% of farmland here was rented in 2022.

15009.story: As of Oct 16, the census value of land and buildings in Maui County was $12,084 an acre in 2022, up 5.4% from $11,466 in 2017. That works out to 1.1% a year. It sits under the Hawaii median of $12,660 and ranks 2nd lowest of 4. Renters worked 19% of the farmland in 2022.
